scope: Offline measurement decomposition and pre-2021 statistical calibration diagnostics; preserve all frozen scorers, responses and prior results
measurement: Compare original Q9 vectors' frozen scores with official per-person Q9_mean on identical rows and positive original weights; distinguish common-support density gap, support changes, aggregate/chart-vintage gap, and chart/initial-headline gap. Only evaluation reads official derived means.
aggregation_candidate: Implement Cox (2009) weighted mid-distribution interpolation from official 2017 Appendix B as a separate sensitivity, not an assertion that it is the correct replacement for continuous Q9 density-mean aggregation. Group equal values before interpolation; do not change the frozen empirical-CDF estimator.
error_decomposition: For model S, reconstructed human H and official O, e=S-O=(S-H)+(H-O). Report exact MSE terms and MAE target-change sensitivity; do not call MAE(H,O)/MAE(S,O) the fraction of model error caused by scoring.
anomaly_year: All twelve months of 2021, chosen by the user before this comparison
fixed_training: 2019-01 through 2020-12 only; assert every training SCE outcome was public by the first 2021 reference cutoff
inner_selection: First18 pre-2021 months fit; next6 pre-2021 months validate alpha on MAE; larger alpha wins ties; refit all24. No 2021 outcome selects alpha or feature family.
rolling_training: Same pre-2021 chosen feature sets and alphas; refit each 2021 month only on earlier rows whose actual SCE first publication date is no later than that month's original shared reference cutoff; label availability checked row by row
model_families: Reuse the previously declared convex MAE/MSE and AR/ridge CPI/simulation/dummy-interaction families; no new threshold search; dummy CPI>=4 fixed
sources: Frozen Core and tau8 expansion; published SCE anchors; BLS first-release CPI features from prior macro calibration
limits: A simulations and mechanisms have already used these historical periods; statistical-coefficient temporal separation does not create an untouched end-to-end forecast test
A personal-date simulation and shared macro reference cutoff remain different information scopes; not certified B forecasting
A high-inflation dummy absent in pre-2021 data has an unestimated effect, not a learned zero response; report support counts
No automatic scorer or production-configuration promotion based on these results
